svg.title: World Cup team net xG per game by tournament result
svg.desc: Scatterplot of every team in complete StatsBomb World Cup tournaments, with tournament result on the x axis and net xG per game on the y axis.
svg.text: Team net xG per game by tournament result
Net xG/game = xG for/game minus xG against/game
